prior_art.why_relevant: Root-caused this exact table's empty-load problem for TB: the Vertica view V_MemberBasedValidValues_View was never created, so tb01_v_memberbasedvalidvalues loaded empty every batch and darwin's BandingProcessor silently failed ccperf ('Performance') banding. Its shipped fix (commits 1be7df2, 46deb35) repointed export_mod.sql at an already-existing real Vertica table named V_MemberBasedValidValues (not the phantom _View) and fixed a ccperf casing bug in pg/load.sql. That real table had no git-tracked definition/refresh mechanism at all — SUP-4738 is the follow-through: turn it into a properly maintained constant table.

knowledge_gained.technical: TB's V_MemberBasedValidValues in Vertica had no git-tracked definition (per SUP-3061's full-history search). SUP-4738 makes it a real constant table: 02.6_load_memberbasedvalidvalues.sql truncates + \copy-loads it from mappings/tb_v_memberbasedvalidvalues.csv every batch run, using the same lightweight mappings/ mechanism TB already uses (02.5_load_mappings.sql) rather than a heavier constant_tables/ deploy process (TB has neither). Downstream export/PG load, already fixed under SUP-3061, is untouched by this ticket. Valid-value attributeids must be lowercase to match config's dataIndex/groupingKey (e.g. 'grade', 'ccperf'); pg/load.sql normalizes only 'ccperf' — 'Grade' and 'SlsR_Band' ship mixed-case from the new CSV and are not normalized downstream.
knowledge_gained.functional: Grade, CC Performance (a 1-5 sales-quintile band), and SlsR Band are planner-facing labels used to group/filter style-colors in Hindsighting screens (Style/Stylecolor/Collection Review). Making their source a version-controlled constant table means these labels are deterministic and deploy-reviewable, instead of depending on an untracked Vertica object that could silently go empty — the exact failure mode planners hit in SUP-3061.
